name: Universidad del Valle
body: nosniff, GA4, a declared language, and http that redirects to https. But the home page's English switch, /loader.php?…idioma=EN, returns 404, so international visitors hit an error on their first click.
lesson: Test the language switcher in every release. It's often the first click for visitors from abroad.
summary: www.univalle.edu.co scores 60 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 11 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 18 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 18 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /directorio-univalle, /correo-electronico-institucional, /index.php/mapa-del-sitio and 14 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 2 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /loader.php?lServicio=Tools2&lTipo=idioma&idioma=EN answered 404, linked from /, /directorio-univalle and 4 more. /loader.php?lServicio=Tools2&lTipo=idioma&idioma=ES answered 404, linked from /, /directorio-univalle and 4 more.
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 18 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 18 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The TLS certificate is valid for 165 more days
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 637 ms
Every page has a meta description
